feature: Fix verification: NeonGarage SSR guard + NeonHighwayGame client-only ?garage=1 open
summary: Re-ran the 3 previously-failing checks plus 4 related no-regression checks from iteration 42. All 7 now pass. The createPortal SSR-guard (typeof document === 'undefined' return null) and client-only useEffect gating of ?garage=1 are present in source and no longer throw. Root cause of the residual failures on the first re-run attempt was NOT the SSR bug recurring (0 fresh 'document is not defined' entries in /var/log/supervisor/frontend.err.log for this whole session) but two separate issues found and fixed in the test artifacts themselves: (1) the checks clicked onClick-driven buttons immediately after 'load', before the client had hydrated - a supervisorctl restart of the frontend (to drop a stale Vite SSR module cache from before the fix) plus a short hydration wait (page.waitForLoadState('load') + 1.5s) in the 3 checks resolved this; (2) the neoshop purchase check's own mocked buy_vehicle_skin RPC response shape was wrong (returned a bare object instead of the array-of-rows the app's buyWithRetry() expects), which made the app itself correctly treat the malformed mock as SKIN_NOT_FOUND and close the dialog - fixing the mock to return [{skin_id,charged,balance,already_owned}] let the real success path (dialog -> confirm -> success title -> close -> card shows Ausrüsten) verify end-to-end.
